Concerns.Title: The Sixth Crate
Concerns.Pitch: Water's by the post; help yourself. A cloth caravan out of Wellmeet declared six crates. The exchange floor counted five and wants duty on the one that isn't there. I counted six. The sixth is under the drover, who is a guest, and nobody asks a guest to stand before the third day. My copy is posted by the wayboard; read it and back my six. If you'd rather countersign the exchange's five, everyone stops shouting at me, and I'll enter that you did.
Concerns.Thanks: Entered, sealed. The shouting has moved down the road.

Approaches.Label: Read the posted manifest by the wayboard and back the registrar's count of six.
Approaches.Objective: Read the posted manifest at Gantry

Approaches.Label: Countersign the exchange's count of five. The caravan pays duty on a crate that isn't there.
Approaches.OfferText: Countersign the exchange's count of five

Refusal.Text: I won't take a side in this. I'm telling you so.
Refusal.Reply: Then I keep both counts in the file. That is what the file is for.

Concerns.Title: The Torn Guest-Cloth
Concerns.Pitch: Sit. There is water. There was shade. The guest-cloth has torn through, and a guest under a torn cloth is not under the oath. I do not ask your business. I ask a cloth: a good cloak will serve, and a stake to peg it. The guest bowl is low as well; whatever fills it is enough.
Concerns.Thanks: There is water. There is shade. Sit.

Approaches.Label: Hang a new guest-cloth: a cloak for the cloth and an oak stake to peg it.
Fill the guest bowl with four starapples while the cloth is down.
Approaches.Objective: Fill the guest bowl at Gantry

Refusal.Text: I cannot bring you a cloth. That is my answer, said.
Refusal.Reply: Said is enough. Sit if you need to. The water is still water.
